purpose: Network shooter prototype: 5 identical playable floors, nine rooms each, with clear routes and non-damaging shooting.
runtimeSurface: Browser WebGL client plus Node.js WebSocket LAN lobby; authored source is Blender.

exceptions: The ramp occupies the north side room to establish a reliable vertical route.

circulation.description: Each floor is a 3 by 3 grid. Central room opens to all four side rooms; every side room opens to its two adjacent corners. A 3m-wide shallow ramp joins each floor to the next.
